text: {"verdict": "refuted", "answer": "The claim is contradicted by the evidence. In 39 euthyroid patients with non-toxic multinodular goitre treated with a single 131I dose, median thyroid volume fell from 73 ml (IQR 50-106) to 29 ml (23-48) at 24 months, a median reduction of 40 ml (60%, p < 0.0001), with half occurring within three months. Radioiodine therefore decreases, not increases, thyroid volume in this condition.", "evidence_used": ["9745001"]}
